floor_history.headline: recon: honest floor 30 (from 46) - LICM hoist of `1<<n` defeated by a multi-set mask, ?:-arms match; residual = env/select global.c priority seat swap (do-while(0) carrier measures 11, mechanism confi
Honest env ref-lift found (split-init accumulation swaps the seat with no FAKE) and the bit-arm shift seat solved; the env-livelen route is measured dead.

Bit-arm seats reduced to an exact local-alloc model: the target's chain must be a per-arm LOCAL quantity, the 3-quantity hand-rolled sort cannot emit the needed order from the measured birth order, an

frontier.hypothesis: The target's bit arm has three block-local quantities born in the order shift, mask, chain (addiu, li, lbu) - the one birth order from which the hand-rolled 3-element sort emits [0,1,2] = the target seats. Finding the C that makes sched1 place the addiu first closes both bit arms at once.
frontier.mechanism: With births shift(10)/mask(12)/chain(14) the priorities are shift 13333, mask 40000, chain 40000; the sort then takes the b>a, not(c>b) branch and returns [0,1,2], i.e. shift $v0, mask $v1, chain $a0 - and the emitted order addiu, li, lbu is exactly the target's.
frontier.next_probe: Read tmp/grind/func_80016E60/dumps/ings.sched for blk 22 and work out why the li outranks the addiu (INSN_PRIORITY tie vs the rank_for_schedule class test against the preceding CALL, tools/gcc-2.7.2/sched.c rank_for_schedule); then look for a byte-neutral C form that raises the addiu's priority or lowers the li's.

frontier.hypothesis: A byte-neutral fourth block-local quantity in each bit arm switches local-alloc to the real qsort path, where the q1 priorities (shift 40000, mask 30000 as qty0, chain 30000 as qty1) already sort to exactly the target seats.
frontier.mechanism: local-alloc.c:1502 qsort(qty_compare_1) is a proper priority sort with a qty-number tie-break, unlike the 3-element special case; the x1 probe proved the switch happens at next_qty >= 4 but its extra insn stretched mask's span and inverted mask vs chain.
frontier.next_probe: Look for a fourth quantity that costs no insn and does not stretch mask's span - e.g. a duplicated read of D_800A3788 into a second variable that jump.c cross-jumping or combine re-merges - and re-read the QTYDBG rows to check mask keeps span 8.

frontier.hypothesis: The env/select seat remains the larger residual; the do-while(0) carrier is the sanctioned fallback but now carries a measured extra cost (the prologue pair) that a byte-clean env lever would not pay.
frontier.mechanism: flow.c:2087 counts reg_n_refs before combine; global.c allocno_compare needs env at 8 weighted refs. E-s3-7 shows the carrier itself perturbs the prologue, so any carrier submission must also explain that pair.
frontier.next_probe: Re-measure the carrier's prologue pair once the bit arms are byte-clean, and compare it against the honest split-init form (33) to see whether the displacement is a wrap artefact or an independent defect.
